entries.title: Alert for Phishing Domain Detection
body: When EASM detects phishing lookalike domains, an alert icon appears on the Lookalike Domains tab in the left-side navigation.
See image.

Additionally, this alert icon appears in the Top 5 Lookalike Domains by Exposure widget displayed on the Insights Overview dashboard and contains a link to the Lookalike Domains page filtered to show the detected phishing domains.
See image.
To learn more, see Accessing & Interacting with the Insights Overview Dashboard.

entries.title: Jira Integration for EASM
body: You can connect your Jira instance with individual EASM organizations to seamlessly create and track Jira tickets for the organization's findings directly from the EASM Admin Portal. You can configure the integration for an organization under Administration > Organizations > [Organization name] > Jira.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring the Jira Integration.
After integrating Jira with an EASM organization, admins with full access to the specific organization can create Jira tickets for findings by filling out a set of predefined Jira fields.
See image.
To learn more, see Creating Jira Tickets for Findings.

The ticket is added to Jira along with specific data from EASM, and the ticket details automatically synchronize between Jira and EASM while the connection established between the two applications with a valid Jira token remains active.

entries.title: Support for EASM API
body: EASM supports the use of APIs for programmatic access to EASM features. The EASM API is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI, a unified programming interface for platform automation. OneAPI secures API authorization with OAuth 2.0. Zscaler's unified identity service, Authentication Service, supports API client management and identity lifecycle management.
To learn more, see Understanding the EASM API.
The EASM API includes the following endpoints to retrieve information about EASM organizations, findings, and lookalike domains:
- GET /organizations
- GET /organizations/:orgId/findings
- GET /organizations/:orgId/findings/:findingId/details
- GET /organizations/:orgId/findings/:findingId/evidence
- GET /organizations/:orgId/findings/:findingId/scan-output
- GET /organizations/:orgId/lookalike-domains
- GET /organizations/:orgId/lookalike-domains/:lookalikeRaw/details
To learn more about each endpoint, see the API Reference.
All endpoints within the EASM API are subject to a rate limit of 1,000 calls per second, per tenant.
To learn more about HTTP error and status codes, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

entries.title: Update to EASM API: New Asset Endpoints
body: The EASM API includes the following new endpoints to retrieve information about the assets discovered for an organization:
- GET /{orgId}/assets
- GET /{orgId}/assets/{assetId}/services
- GET /{orgId}/assets/{assetId}/technologies
- GET /{orgId}/assets/{assetId}/certificates

These endpoints allow you to retrieve the list of all assets attributed to an organization and detailed information about an asset, including the SSL/TLS certificates that the asset uses, services running on it, and technologies used on it.
To learn more, see the API Reference.

entries.title: Return on Investment Score for Findings
body: EASM determines the risk impact of each finding and its associated financial implications and expresses it as the Return on Investment (ROI) score to help organizations proactively remediate high-priority threats that can result in significant business impact. You can view the findings' ROI score on the new Findings Impact page under Insights in the left-side navigation menu. This page provides a list of all findings, the corresponding ROI score, the number of impacted assets, and percentage of overall assets that are affected by the finding.
See image.
In addition, findings with the highest ROI scores are highlighted on the Insights dashboard in a new widget (Top 5 Findings by ROI) for greater visibility.
See image.
To learn more, see About Findings Impact and Accessing & Interacting with the Insights Overview Dashboard.

entries.title: Generating Reports for Organizations
body: You can generate reports for individual EASM organizations in the PPTX format, translating real-time technical security data from automated discovery findings into actionable, strategic insights for diverse stakeholders. Admins with full permission to an organization can generate reports for the organization under Administration > Organization > [Organization name] > Generate Report.
See image.
To learn more, see Generating Reports.

entries.title: Update to Asset Status
body: When assets are attributed to an organization through the discovery process, they are initially assigned the Candidate status by default. EASM automatically validates these assets and updates the status to Approved only for assets that are successfully verified. This ensures that customers receive high-confidence and reliable asset data.
To learn more, see Understanding Asset Details.

entries.title: Discovery Chain for Assets
body: On the Asset Details page (and the drawer), EASM provides an asset discovery chain for source traceability and attestation of the asset's connection to the organization. The discovery chain is presented as a link chain, featuring the seed asset, intermediate nodes, and the current asset in a sequence, along with the services and attributes used to identify assets in each discovery hop as applicable.
See image.
To learn more, see Understanding Asset Details.

entries.title: Scan Evidence for Findings
body: On the Finding Details page, EASM presents the full scan results used to identify the finding and specific portions of the scan that serve as matching evidence for the finding. This information is available for each finding, providing attestation of detected findings and an investigative trail for admins to self-validate their findings.
See image.
To learn more, see Understanding Finding Details.
